name: 提示词实验台
description: 会话级的系统提示词开关，用于提示词工程实验：对比同一次请求在「带宿主提示词」「去掉身份段与文档段」「只发人设」三种条件下表现如何。默认关闭，未执行命令时不读任何文件、不改一个字节的提示词。状态只存在内存里，关掉应用即消失。

en.name: Prompt Lab
en.description: A per-session switch for the system prompt, for prompt-engineering work: compare how the same request behaves with the harness prompt present, with its identity and documentation sections removed, or with only your persona. Off by default; with the command never run, nothing is read from disk and the prompt is unchanged. State lives in memory only, so quitting the app cannot leave a session running with a prompt you forgot about.
en.safetyNotes: No network access and no disk writes. The only read is the persona file the user names explicitly with /promptlab source, and only while the experiment is switched on. State is per session and never persisted.
